Character sprites extracted from D.C.5 Sweet Happiness.

Due to the large number of character sprites and expression variants, the complete character sprite collection has been divided into four galleries.

D.C.5 Sweet Happiness uses HXV4-based resource obfuscation, so the original sprite assets had to be extracted and reconstructed before they could be organized.

This collection contains all valid character sprite combinations available in the game, based on the original sprite composition rules.

This gallery is Part 4 of 4 and the final part of the collection.
